what: A small graphic (heart or stamp) pops out overshooting once in .7 seconds from .35x and transparent (cubic-bezier(.68,-.6,.32,2)), then from 1.6 seconds later pulses to 1.15x twice every 3.4 seconds — thump-thump, rest, thump-thump (the beat is ease-in-out, with peaks at 4·12% and 67·75%)

options.on: load (default — after delay once attached) · enter (once, when it comes 10% above the bottom of the screen)
options.delay: Delay before popping out (sec), default 0 — the original Hero is 2.9 after load
options.beat: Seconds from popping out until the pulse starts, default 1.6

from.where: index.html .m-key__copy .img svg (heart inside the semicircle line at the center of the Hero · index.js 2900ms show · 4500ms move)
